reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a way to profit from cryptocurrency, claiming that a split program can double a token portfolio and increase its value in under 10 weeks. It directly urges viewers to register while also tying bonuses to building a sales team, making the solicitation depend on both token-return claims and recruitment.

citations.quote: OneCoin is a new kind of cryptocurrency with strong values connected to innovation and profitability for holders of the coin.
the split program can double your tokens portfolio each portfolio has the chance to split up to two times this means if you are active you can increase your portfolio value in just under 10 weeks.
By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE network, and by popularizing ONE COIN, you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team.
Take a chance and register Today.
REGISTER FOR FREE... CLICK HERE: https://www.onecoin.eu/signup/Champs0101.

opening.argument: The presentation describes an education program, not a guaranteed investment result: members are told they will learn trading strategies and can practice trading, while the portfolio claim is expressly conditional on being active. The supplied narration does not define that condition or establish that any viewer is promised a return. It also does not establish what the tokens are worth or whether they can be converted into money. A claim about potential portfolio growth deserves scrutiny, but the material here leaves those practical outcomes unverified rather than demonstrating a guaranteed payout.

citations.quote: OneCoin will be introduced through our education programme where you learn about trading strategies and how to profit from trading with cryptocurrency.

These tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our exchange with thousands of other members, practice your skills and let you profit from what you have learned through our oneAcademy program.
this means if you are active you can increase your portfolio value in just under 10 weeks.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats a conditional portfolio statement as proof of a guaranteed return. But “if you are active” makes the claim conditional, and the supplied text does not say that every purchaser will double a portfolio, receive cash, or obtain a particular realized return. The registration invitation shows promotion; it does not fill in the missing terms or establish what happens to a participant's money or tokens.

citations.quote: the split program can double your tokens portfolio each portfolio has the chance to split up to two times this means if you are active you can increase your portfolio value in just under 10 weeks.
Take a chance and register Today.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The conditional wording does not neutralize the explicit promise of portfolio doubling: the narration says a portfolio can split twice and describes an increase in value in under ten weeks. The video is not merely explaining trading; it presents OneCoin as profitable and urges registration. The absence of proof that tokens convert to cash does not make those return claims less consequential.

opening.argument: The material can reasonably be read as a promotional introduction to a proposed cryptocurrency education and trading service. Its central explanation is that members receive education packages, learn strategies, and use tokens to practice trading; the sampled presentation also depicts the presenter alongside education-program material. That is different from evidence that the speaker demonstrates a functioning exchange or proves a return. The content may make ambitious claims, but the supplied record does not independently establish the package terms, the exchange's operation, or token value.

citations.quote: OneCoin will be introduced through our education programme where you learn about trading strategies and how to profit from trading with cryptocurrency.
With our education packages, you will receive free trading tokens, so-called one tokens.
These tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our exchange with thousands of other members, practice your skills

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's cited doubling and team-building statements show that the introduction is promotional, but they do not establish that the described education or trading service is fictitious or that a viewer is guaranteed a financial outcome. The narration explicitly presents learning, practice, and following business updates as part of the offer. A promotional tone is not by itself evidence of how the service operates or what a participant ultimately receives.

citations.quote: you will receive free trading tokens, so-called one tokens.
practice your skills and let you profit from what you have learned through our oneAcademy program.
get access to your education packages and follow the progress of the business and stay updated on the latest news

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling it an educational introduction does not change what it solicits: the program is presented as a route to profit, includes a rapid portfolio-growth claim, and invites viewers to register. The educational framing is part of the pitch, not a demonstration that the advertised exchange works or that the claimed growth is attainable.

opening.argument: At minimum, the text describes an offered package and a membership or marketing opportunity, with registration presented as free. It does not show a viewer paying a deposit, submitting credentials, receiving money, or completing a transaction; nor does the supplied material establish the destination or terms behind the registration link. The sales-team bonuses are disclosed in the narration rather than hidden. These limits do not verify the offer, but they matter: the record supports a promotional pitch, not a demonstrated payment or credential-harvesting mechanism.

citations.quote: REGISTER FOR FREE... CLICK HERE: https://www.onecoin.eu/signup/Champs0101.
With our education packages, you will receive free trading tokens, so-called one tokens.
By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE network, and by popularizing ONE COIN, you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution points to token-growth language, a sales team, and a registration call, but none of those quoted lines demonstrates a required deposit, a guaranteed cash return, or an undisclosed recruitment condition. The call to register is expressly described as free, and the bonus connection to a sales team is stated openly. The evidence leaves important commercial terms unanswered; it does not establish those missing mechanisms.

citations.quote: REGISTER FOR FREE... CLICK HERE: https://www.onecoin.eu/signup/Champs0101.
By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE network, and by popularizing ONE COIN, you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A free registration prompt does not answer whether the education packages or tokens later require payment, and the narration explicitly links bonuses to building a sales team. More importantly, the pitch separately promises potential token-portfolio growth on a short timeline. The absence of a shown transaction limits what can be concluded about the mechanics, but it does not erase the financial solicitation in the video itself.
